title: constrain's floor spells every discovered instrument with forward slashes on Windows
intention: constrain.discovered_instruments returns each instrument spelled with forward slashes on every box.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: test_the_floor_discovers_only_the_tickets_own_component fails on Windows with the backslash spelling, and the new proof's two teeth fail on the unfixed constrain.py and pass on the fixed one
traces_to: Law 3: a path spelling is not known portable until measured; Law 4: enforced by a proof on the spelling.
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/constrain.py replace the two str(path.relative_to(root)) calls in discovered_instruments with path.relative_to(root).as_posix(). Red-first proof: a scratch class-space with three components, claimed and unclaimed floors, asserts the slash spelling.

clauses.claim: a claimed floor over a scratch class-space returns exactly ['cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_tester_holds.py'] on Windows, where it returned the backslash spelling
an unclaimed floor over the same root returns three instruments, none containing a backslash

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: test_the_floor_discovers_only_the_tickets_own_component fails on Windows with the backslash spelling, and the new proof's two teeth fail on the unfixed constrain.py and pass on the fixed one
measured.how: ran both proofs bare on akiendell before and after the two-line change
